weekly_calendar.hook:
We accidentally burned $412 in 14 hours on AWS because of a single unbatched Redis scan across 50,000 agent sessions.

Here is the post-mortem and the 12-line Lua script that fixed it.

draft_structure.hook: Specific dollar cost + time window + precise architectural cause.
draft_structure.friction: How an innocent loop in an agent session manager triggered exponential redis latency at p99.
draft_structure.data_proof: Flame graph showed 82% CPU time stuck on KEYS instead of SCAN.
draft_structure.takeaway: Never use client-side loops for multi-key deletes; push execution to Redis via atomic Lua scripts.
draft_structure.discussion: Are you running redis cluster or single node for your agent memory stores?

weekly_calendar.visual_direction: Screenshot of terminal CPU flame graph before/after Lua script optimization with dark background.
weekly_calendar.follow_up_action: Drop the public GitHub Gist link in the 1st comment; reply to engineers asking about Redis cluster compatibility within 45 mins.
